name: Emperor Sutoku
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 77); Porter’s note gives the dates as: reigned 1124–1141; d. 1164.

poems.title: The rock divides the stream in two
poems.author: Emperor Sutoku
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 77
poems.text:
The rock divides the stream in two,
And both with might and main
Go tumbling down the waterfall;
But well I know the twain
Will soon unite again.

poems.title: 77. 瀬を早み 岩にせかるる 瀧川の (Se o hayami iwa ni sekaruru takigawa no)
poems.author: Emperor Sutoku
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 詞花集
poems.text:
瀬を早み 岩にせかるる 瀧川の
われても末に 逢はむとぞ思ふ
